summary: Proposal context for converting the dashboard from Hono + standalone Vite React to TanStack Start, with TanStack DB collections/live queries consuming Chokidar/SSE events. Preserve cartographer-dashboard CLI, /skill:dashboard, local loopback-only read-only behavior, and .plan/_private safety. External research used Context7 for /websites/tanstack_start_framework_react, /websites/tanstack_db, and /paulmillr/chokidar plus Brave Search for TanStack docs. Key risks: Start Node/package runtime fit, read-only TanStack DB event semantics, dependency/script churn, and ADR-0003 supersession.
open_questions: Confirm exact TanStack Start Node runtime/build entrypoint before removing Hono runtime code.
Decide in ADR whether TanStack Start + DB supersedes ADR-0003 or amends it while retaining Chokidar/read-only constraints.

summary: P0 implementation context and result: added TanStack Start/Router/DB/Query dependency baseline plus nitro dev dependency, created dashboard minimal Start app with Vite Start plugin before React and Nitro Node output, generated routeTree, added placeholder / and /topics/$topic routes, and documented runtime spike compatibility boundary. Existing Hono runtime and standalone Vite client remain active until later phases.
open_questions: P1 must adapt cartographer-dashboard runtime to launch dashboard/.output/server/index.mjs or an equivalent Start handler.

summary: P1 implementation context and result: adapted dashboard/src/server/runtime.ts so cartographer-dashboard start launches the built TanStack Start Node output when dashboard/.output/server/index.mjs exists, while retaining Hono fallback until route parity is complete. Preserved loopback host validation, status/stop metadata outside .plan, topic deep links, stale PID cleanup, and source-checkout compatibility. Updated CLI tests to validate shell/topic serving instead of Hono-only /api/health for this bridge phase.
validation_commands: npm run check:scripts && npm run typecheck
open_questions: P2 must port/read-only API routes into Start; until then, Hono fallback remains for unbuilt source checkouts and old API parity.

summary: P2 implemented Start-side read-only API parity for dashboard endpoints, reusing Hono artifact readers and shared success/failure response contracts through a lazy-import server helper. Added a Start runtime API smoke test suite that validates health/overview/topics/documents/graph/events/file and ADR endpoints, plus private-file blocking against temp fixtures.
open_questions: Finalize SSE event behavior in P4 while retaining API surface compatibility in P2.

summary: P3 added a TanStack DB layer and collection-backed query integrations for dashboard overview, topics, topic artifacts/documents/graphs, ADR list, health, and live status, preserving read-only semantics by omitting mutations and surfacing failures through ApiResponse. Added runtime API-backed query loaders and collection utilities consumed by the existing shell client and refresh logic tests.

summary: P4 completed the client-side realtime bridge integration by writing SSE live status and latest reload events into TanStack DB collections for collection-backed diagnostics and future live UI use. Collection invalidation logic remains targeted via existing live-refetch planning and start API event routes are unchanged, preserving read-only semantics and private-path filtering.

summary: P5 completed the route-driven UI migration by making Start route components own topic-route navigation, binding DashboardShell server/artifact data to TanStack DB live-query selectors, and removing manual dashboardApi fetch/refetch state from the shell. The live badge now consumes DB-backed live status/latest-event collections with local SSE fallback, preserving the existing cockpit UI, local UI state, graph/document/review workflow surfaces, read-only behavior, and private blocked-state expectations.

P6 completed legacy cleanup/docs/ADR readiness by switching dashboard build/check/package/smoke validation to the TanStack Start full-stack output, documenting retained Hono modules as compatibility-only fallback/shared route-contract code, updating README and dashboard skill language for the single full-stack dashboard model, validating package/smoke/full-check/topic/graph gates, and accepting ADR-0005 to supersede ADR-0003 for the normal dashboard runtime while preserving read-only loopback/private-path constraints.
